programme.desc: Being an ‘only lamb in the flock’ Timmy has been used to getting his own way. Now for the first time Timmy is going to have to learn to get along with other little animals. Timmy is going to Nursery! Self-willed and naughty Timmy is going to have to learn how to share things with other youngsters and think about their feelings – not just his. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!

Suzu sube al escenario y canta. ¡Ay! Astro y Astro-Kitty piensan que su voz chillona debería ser suficiente para espantar a cualquier fantasma, pero los ruidos inquietantes continúan hasta que el Equipo Astro descubre al enamorado Derek, un ave lira capaz de reproducir cualquier sonido humano, los cuales incorpora en una canción con la esperanza de atraer a una pareja. Él y Suzu cantan a dúo y casi "echan abajo el teatro" cuando sus voces funden el cableado defectuoso de los micrófonos y provocan un incendio. El Equipo Astro apaga el fuego y salva el teatro y, para sorpresa de todos, la canción de Derek le consigue una pareja.

These are the stories most visitors never hear… until now.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.sub-title: DIRT - "Exploring Japanese Street Food and Local Surfing Spots | DIRT Japan: Kyushu"
programme.desc: "Hope you're hungry. In this episode, come along as we eat our weight in sushi and ramen, meet nori farmers and wagyu ranchers, and make some new surfing buddies along the way. P.S. if you're hungry for more Japan content, stay tuned for our next two episodes. - In this episode of DIRT, the crew road tripped around Kyushu. The food culture in Kyushu dates back to the emperors of Japan, and the Black Current off the eastern shore has shaped the island's cuisine for centuries. The DIRT team followed that current up the coastline, surfing with new friends and tasting new flavors. And with each stop, we learned even more about how the traditions we keep can honor thousands of years of knowledge—and point the way to the future."

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: The introduction of non-native species into Australia has had a large impact on native species. Ongoing management throughout the country is a daily task. Dan Cabela meets some of the people taking on this challenge.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff hear about the dangers of fishing for Bluefin Tuna in the Atlantic Ocean from locals in Gloucester, Massachusetts. Then they head 30 miles out onto the open ocean with Darrin of Reel Respect Charters in the hopes of landing their own giant.

programme.title: The Reel American Road Trip
programme.desc: Danny goes perch fishing with Ed Love. They are joined by a few youngsters from down south for a good ol’ fashioned fishing trip and fish fry.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: From country music star Brian Kelley’s big 56’ Sunny Briggs Sportfishing Yacht, to getting caught in a storm aboard a small Hurricane deck boat in the Gulf of Mexico, this episode of Stomping Grounds has host Ryan McVinney exploring boat culture in Florida’s Panhandle region, from the Emerald Coast to The Big Bend and the Forgotten Coast. Brian Kelley, aka “Beach Cowboy”, or BK for short, makes up one half of the country music group Florida Georgia Line (FGL) and has just released his own solo album Sunshine State of Mind. Kelley invites viewers aboard his vessel the “Brittney Marie” which was named after his wife, for a look at the couple’s Stomping Grounds. Songs from his album play on the boat’s sound system - including a tune about shopping for a boat on Boat Trader

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael and Larken head to South Texas in search of trophy-sized trout. Along the way they make a pitstop to gear up and custom-build a Texas wading rod.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: In the thrilling season finale of "Goin' Coastal," host Josh Calhoon takes his daughter, Lily, on an unforgettable birthday fishing adventure in Destin, Florida. They target mighty amberjack, battling these fierce fighters, when Lily hooks into a surprising Goliath grouper, leading to an epic showdown. This heartwarming and action-packed episode captures the essence of family, the thrill of the catch, and the beauty of coastal living. Don't miss this special finale filled with love, laughter, and coastal charm.

programme.title: Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: Ryan bowhunts Saskatchewan for his first full velvet whitetail.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle explores the Great Lakes on his Sea-Doo in search of walleye and lake trout.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green and his buddy Jeremy set out on a buffalo hunt in the great state of Oklahoma. Along the way they learn about the true past and potential future of the American Buffalo from several interesting people with different perspectives.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green heads to Yankton, South Dakota to learn about the history of the Missouri river and the people who count on the river for sustenance. The invasive carp are set to destroy this rich ecosystem and Kyle aims to stop this fish with his best weapon, a great recipe.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green meets up with his friends at the National Wild Turkey Federation to dive into turkey conservation, and hunt the largest subspecies of wild turkey. Kyle finishes off this episode with his most favorite wild game recipe, boneless wild turkey wings.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark is wrapping up his Argentina hunt and heading to Entre Rios to track down the final two birds on his list: the Rock Pigeon and the Eared Dove. This area is home to over 10 million birds, making it a prime hunting ground. With flocks of pigeons and doves filling the skies, Mark is set for a fast-paced, action-packed finish to his hunt—a perfect end to an unforgettable adventure.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This hunt tells a story in two parts. The first chapter follows Earl Peterson, Mark’s dad, as he steps into the field with one specific goal in mind. Experience, patience, and timing all play a role as the morning unfolds, setting the tone for the rest of the adventure. The second chapter shifts to Mark’s turn. On the coldest morning of the trip so far, the team heads into black-faced impala country. Wind, shifting conditions, and sharp eyes keep things interesting as they cover ground and look for the right opportunity. Every move matters, and nothing comes easy.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson is in the final stretch of completing the South America Upland Slam. Having already checked off nine species in Argentina, he now finds himself in Peru, where he faces the challenge of tracking down two elusive species to complete his list: the Andean Tinamou and the Western Peruvian Dove.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Eastern Cape of South Africa: Blue Duiker with Dogs"
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson as he continues his hunting journey through the Eastern Cape of South Africa. In this episode, Mark takes on a unique challenge: pursuing the elusive blue duiker, one of Africa’s - smallest and most difficult antelope species to hunt. Watch as he teams up with local houndsman Robin and a specialized pack of dogs to flush these rabbit-sized trophies from thick coastal - vegetation. Experience the fast-paced action of shotgun hunting for quick-moving targets in dense cover, where success depends on split-second timing and expert dog work.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Northern Cape of South Africa: Axis and Fallow Deer"
programme.desc: Through the rugged terrain of South Africa's Northern Cape, Mark Peterson sets out in pursuit of a rare and thrilling double, the Axis and Fallow Deer. Though non-native, these species have flourished in the region's diverse habitat. Join Mark on this unforgettable experience under the African skies, during this unique hunting experience in South Africa.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: In this episode, Mark Peterson finds himself deep in the heart of Peru and focuses on completing the prestigious South America Upland Slam. With only one bird remaining, the Western Peruvian Dove, the trip has led him to a private hunting property. This final challenge will take place over a cut cornfield, a favorite spot for the doves. To blend in, Mark and his team craft a makeshift blind using a mix of corn stalks, and timber, just enough cover while allowing for a clear shot. These West Peruvian Doves are known for their erratic flight patterns, often bouncing from one tree to another in a random manner, making timing and placement critical.

programme.title: Bearded Buck
programme.desc: In this episode, Jerry and Austin are joined by Kirk Shebrine and his close friend Scott as they head back to the Cornhusker state to hunt turkeys. They've called in a ton of turkeys over the years but this time they're using a reaping decoy to try to get up close and personal with these Nebraskan long beards. This is a method that they've never tried before and with new methods, comes new challenges.

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode and adventure, we travel to Williston North Dakota for the Williston Fire Fighter fishing tournament that helps support their rural volunteer fire department. The conditions were TOUGH on Lake Sakakawea!! We learn about the Volunteer fire department and the sacrifice it takes to be there for the community. We also highlight our next SCHEELS Hometown Hero, Jim Moe! Click PLAY and check out the good things happening in North Dakota!

programme.title: American Heroes Outdoors
programme.desc: On this episode, we travel to NW Iowa and join forces with the Iowa Great lakes Fishing club to take some deserving local Veterans out fishing. This area has some amazing fisheries and we set out to prove all that true! We also highlight our next SCHEELS hometown hero, Tyler Hicks of the Rudd Fire department...Click PLAY and join us in celebrating our nations servicemen and women!

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Motorcycle junkie and Army veteran Dave Allen recounts the terrifying prospect of facing chemical warfare during Operation Desert Storm with host Jay Garstecki and special guest Paul Sr. from American Choppers.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Shot through the neck on Fort Hood in Texas, Green Beret John Arroyo recounts coming face to face with his attacker and Jesus blinding his would be killer.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This Kentucky trip is one we’ll be talking about for a long time. Three longbeards hit the ground, but honestly, it’s the time spent in the woods with good friends that made this hunt what it was. We had birds gobbling, lots of laughs, and a memories that will last a lifetime, and that’s what makes turkey hunting so addicting. These are the kind of hunts you don’t take for granted.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Four minutes. That’s all we had left before cutoff time and somehow, it all came together. After a tough morning hunt in the Illinois woods, everything changed in the final moments. We finally got a longbeard to commit, and we made it count just before time ran out. This is one of those hunts that reminds you why we do it.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Mark Scroggins and his family are in Oklahoma and spot a big gobbler from the road. They are pretty sure they can get in position to call him in but they have to be quick without being seen. His step-daughter Destiny is behind the trigger and Mark just about puts this ol gobbler in her lap!

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Two of the best in the game, get to experience one unforgettable Nebraska hunt. Billy Yargus and Phillip Vanderpool are at Hidden Valley Outfitters in Arnold, Nebraska for a turkey hunt that turned into one they will never forget. Patience, experience, and elite calling paid off when these longbeards finally committed, and came all the way to 20 steps.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: After 3 days of grinding public land in Ohio, nothing seemed to come together. Isaac, Dylan, and Paul Campbell hunted daylight to dark, getting on birds but never closing the deal. Finally, they had a solid game plan for the next morning, but the Excursion wouldn’t start. After wasting half the day trying to fix it, we honestly considered heading back to Alabama. That’s when Jeff Danker reached out after seeing a social post and sent us a pin to one of his Ohio leases. We scouted it that evening, found birds, and on a rainy morning the next day, everything finally came together. Sometimes all it takes is one more push.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Cedros Island Goes Off, Part Two
programme.desc: We're returning to one of our all-time favorite destinations in Baja, Mexico - Cedros Island, with Jose and Cedros Outdoor Adventures. People often ask us, 'Why do you return to Cedros Island?' The answer is straightforward: the fishing is absolutely ridiculous almost every single time. Our Stoked on Fishing charter makes a point of showing up in the middle of October for a reason. That reason? It's all about the variety of species available to catch, starting with yellowfin tuna, dorado, halibut, and the elusive Mr. Yellowtail. It's game time - let's go fishing in Baja!

programme.desc: The men and women who serve our country have overcome a substantial amount of adversity and challenges while in service. When they come home it can feel like merging into oncoming traffic at full speed. We take a look at a few young veterans who have faced the emotional struggles of coming home, and the outlets to cope with their post-traumatic stress.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Day 3 focuses on meeting anger and fear with compassion rather than resistance. By paying gentle attention to difficult emotions, we learn they are not bad—only painful when they define us. Using the breath as an anchor, we develop a kinder, wiser relationship to our inner experience.

programme.title: Compassionate Resilience with Sharon Salzberg

programme.desc: Lucas, a wealthy French entrepreneur, heads to Montana for a very attractive business proposal. When there he meets Robin, falls in love, and whisks her away to Paris on a whirlwind Christmas Adventure. But will business bring an end to this romance?

programme.title: Civil Love (2012)
programme.desc: Rachel is a widow during the Civil War who holds the South responsible for her husband's death. When a wounded enemy soldier takes refuge in her barn, Rachel reluctantly helps him. As she gets to know him more, she realizes she must protect him from the dangerous men pursuing him, and discovers a courage she didn't know she had - the courage to love again.

programme.title: Lost in Love (2023)
programme.desc: Two tourists in Turkey get left behind by their tour bus after visiting an archaeological site. Without their belongings, they must make their way back to Istanbul, improvising along the way with meager means.

programme.title: A Crafty Christmas Romance (2020)
programme.desc: Mandy, the owner of a craft and hobby store, discovers an old copy of “A Christmas Carol” among donations for a book and toy donation drive. In the book is a letter to Santa from 70 years ago and a valuable coin. Mandy sets out to find the owner of the book, letter and coin with the help of Jonah, a contractor who first came upon and donated the book. Along the way, they find clues that lead them closer to the author, and to each other, but can Mandy return everything to the book owner in time for Christmas and make her own Christmas wish come true?

programme.title: Timeless Love (2019)
programme.desc: Megan seems to have the perfect life with a wonderful husband named Thomas and 2 adorable children. Then she finds herself awakening from a coma – and discovers she is not and has never been married. But when she meets Thomas for real, she seizes the chance to help him fall in love with her, again—for the first time.

programme.desc: La amiga de Ariana quiere que deje a su novio por él; Samantha se declara en huelga porque teme que su novio la engañe.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Dos niños con dificultades médicas tienen un sueño por cumplir.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Carmen fue engañada por un hombre que conoció en línea después de querer una vida mejor para su hijo.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Los adultos mayores colombianos están perdiendo casas y negocios por ser estafados por sus abogados.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Tres hombres, acusados injustamente de abusos, luchan por su libertad tras años de cárcel y sufrimiento. A pesar de pruebas que demuestran su inocencia, la verdad tardó demasiado en salir a la luz. ¿Quién paga por el daño de una falsa denuncia?

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En La Virginia, Risaralda, Heidy Yuliani Restrepo, una niña de 11 años, desapareció el 31 de diciembre de 2013 y fue hallada muerta días después en un caño. La investigación señaló a su propia madre, María Preselia Martínez, como responsable del crimen, motivado presuntamente por la pérdida de una sim card. Fue condenada por homicidio agravado y cumple su condena en la cárcel de mujeres La Badea, en Pereira.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Florencia, Caquetá, Lina, embarazada de siete meses, fue asesinada frente a su casa. Aunque el sicario escapó, un testigo señaló a Marmolejo, pareja de la víctima y padre de su bebé, como el autor intelectual del crimen. Pruebas contundentes, incluyendo el testimonio del propio pistolero, confirman que Marmolejo contrató el asesinato para deshacerse de Lina y estar con otra mujer.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Alberto Elías Orozco, empresario dueño de la fábrica "Yogurozco" en Cali, fue asesinado junto a su esposa Macclly Arbeláez en marzo de 2012 cuando se dirigían a misa. Tras varias hipótesis, se descubrió que su propio hermano, Juan Carlos, contrató sicarios para matarlos, motivado por la codicia y el deseo de convertirse en el único heredero de sus bienes.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Heidy Guzmán, de 10 años, desapareció en Tolima en 2007. Fue hallada sin vida tras dos semanas. La investigación reveló abuso y homicidio.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Jessica Mayerli Alza, una estudiante de 16 años, es hallada desmembrada dentro de una maleta en el sur de Bogotá. La investigación reveló que Andrea, su mejor amiga, la asesinó al descubrir que Jessica sostenía una relación con su esposo, Leimar. Autoridades sospechan que Andrea tuvo cómplices en el crimen. Un año después, Andrea Valdez Contreras fue condenada a 345 meses de prisión por homicidio agravado.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Óscar es asesinado en su cuarto. Al principio parecía suicidio, pero su amigo Yeison fue arrestado y reveló que la ex esposa, Paola, lo mandó matar por el seguro. Yeison recibe 17 años de cárcel. Paola proclama su inocencia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Olga Lucía Gaviria y su hija María Ángel fueron asesinadas en Medellín en 2010. El padrastro, Edilson de Jesús Taborda, fue condenado a 60 años por celos enfermizos tras pruebas forenses que lo vincularon al doble homicidio.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Annie demanda a su ex mejor amiga Olivia por 150.000 dólares de angustia emocional. Olivia, una vez dama de honor, secuestró los planes de boda, cambiando de lugar y de vestidos. Annie se siente traicionada y retira a Olivia de la fiesta nupcial. Olivia se defiende, dice que mejoró la boda.

programme.title: Juez Mom

programme.title: Juez Mom

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Lola, del icónico programa infantil Plaza Sésamo, comparte cómo ella y el equipo de producción se adaptaron a la pandemia mediante video llamadas para seguir conectando con los niños. programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Luz Mary y Yon Fredy, tras perder tres embarazos, esperaban con ilusión a su bebé Salvador. Aunque finalmente los dejaron pasar, ya era demasiado tarde: perdieron a su bebé y con él, todas sus ilusiones de ser padres.

programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Legendary drag racer Don “The Snake” Prudhomme proves he is no stranger to the thrill of racing rivalry. Prudhomme’s career and subsequent competition with driver Tom “The Mongoose” McEwan earned the pair an unforgettable imprint on American pop culture. Legions of kids in the 60’s and 70’s flocked to the shelves for Snake and Mongoose Matchbox cars which helped make drag racing an undisputable American pastime. Famed director Ron Howard makes an appearance to discuss the incredible stories hidden within the world of Formula 1 Racing, the topic of his latest, epic feature ‘Rush”.

programme.title: AmeriCarna

programme.title: AmeriCarna

programme.desc: Ray uncovers the infamous “Brawner Hawk” – from the Dean Van Lines team – that became the breakout car in the career of Mario Andretti. After an award winning stop at Concours Amelia Island, the car heads to the 100th running of Indy 500 where Mario Andretti himself gets behind the wheel.

Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: AmeriCarna

It’s an intimate look at the King’s incredible automobiles and their secrets that only Elvis knew.

programme.desc: Some of our most loved are the furry kind. We begin with Cheryl Sleboda, and a cosplay idea to turn you into your favorite animal with furry ears. Finally we have a project for the littlest hero and a baby bottle cover from Joanne Banko.

programme.title: Off Our Needles

programme.title: Off Our Needles
programme.sub-title: Stacked Increases + FOX PAWS Knitting Pattern

programme.title: Artist's Academy presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Welcome to Artists's Academy where we are dedicated to making you a better artist. We believe everyone has an artist within, waiting to be unleashed. Our mission is to be your ultimate resource for visual art education using tutorials covering everything from fundamental techniques to advanced concepts in painting and drawing.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: The right tools can unleash your creativity. Designer Brenda Schweder shows how to make wire frames and captures on a stationary jig. Illusion-style necklaces with crystals are easy and quick to make using tips and tricks from Katie's Beading Lesson.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Cindy Holsclaw takes traditional beadwork in a whole new direction using half-Tila beads to make a bezel setting for a crystal Rivoli. She creates beautiful earrings, a bracelet and more with a circular peyote beadweaving stitch using two-hole beads. In Katie's Beading Lesson, learn to make a wire-wrapped leather cuff.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: Titles start the story. Calligrapher Joanne Fink creates luscious lettering and Julie Fei-Fan Balzer shares her favorite title ideas. Christine Drumheller has a tip for making mini-albums and Ashley Horton lets loose with foils and colors to create attention- grabbing titles.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: Keep track of time in an artistic way. Metal artist Mary Hettmansperger crafts clock parts into a necklace. For his favorite time piece, his phone, tool expert Joe Rotella makes a decorative stand. Mixed media artist Rae Missigman captures moments in time in an artful clipboard journal. Artist Jane Dunnewold has more artful ideas to share.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Angela shows you how to easily make a stash-buster pieced quilt back that can either match or contrast with your quilt top.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: This week's quilt radiates piece and love. Angela uses color placement for a heart-shaped quilt that's easier to make than it looks. IMPORTANT NOTE: The "Piece & Love" quilt designed by Audrey Mann and Dianne Brinton is no longer included with the class.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Angela's been practicing her magic tricks! Tonight, she amazes with a magnificent optical illusion quilt. Watch as she uses solid pre-cuts to magically create her star blocks.

programme.sub-title: Bonus: Tips for Picking Quilt Designs

programme.title: US Open Pickleball Championships 2025
programme.sub-title: US Open 2025 - Women's Sr. Pro Doubles - Courter/Carter vs. Dawson/Williams
programme.desc: This championship game highlights the strategic play, including lobs and speed-ups, as both teams battle for the gold. Jen Dawson is noted as being a seasoned player on this court, having a triple crown in the Senior Pro divisions.

programme.title: European Pickleball Championship
programme.sub-title: Men's Singles Open Final - Chaudry vs. Karbownik
programme.desc: The 2025 European Pickleball Championships in Rome, Italy, concludes its first day with the historic Men's Singles Open Final under the floodlights. England's captain James Chaudry, the only active European player with a DUPR rating over 6.0, faces off against Poland's Bartosz Karbownik (referred to as Kabosnik/Kabashnik in audio).Chaudry dominates early with a mix of power and precise cross-court angles, taking the first game decisively. While Karbownik produces moments of brilliance, including a spectacular passing shot, he struggles with his footing on the clay surface. Witness Team England secure the gold medal in the inaugural singles event of the championships.

programme.title: Inside DUPR Pickleball
programme.desc: In this episode, Tito explains how the DUPR rating system works, why ratings can feel so emotional, the truth behind the DUPR Reset, how reliability score affects your rating, and why your DUPR is a tool to find level-based play — not a number that defines you. programme.title: Robot Wars

programme.title: Robot Wars

programme.title: Robot Wars

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Veterans and Newcomers once again face the eliminators and Dead Metal tries to make a friend. A house robot gets flipped, causing the others to go on a rampage. A uniquely designed robot takes on Pinball Warrior and two more competitors stare down Shunt in Sumo Bash.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A single strike spells trouble for a robot in the eliminators. A fleeting alliance forms as competitor and house robot team up to make an offering to the pit. This week’s Pinball Warrior has high-hopes for a standout performance.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A robot with a unique strategy takes part in this week’s heat. Is it a recipe for success, or a fancy gimmick? The house robot’s manners are at an all-time low as they continue to attack after cease is called.

programme.title: Robot Wars

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Torturada en Siria; A Venezuela con mi hija
programme.desc: Sarah fue violada y torturada por abandonar el islam y convertirse al cristianismo. Camila está decepcionada de vivir en los Estados Unidos, quiere divorciarse y llevarse a su hija a Venezuela.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amiga, ahora madrastra; Calientes y caritativos
programme.desc: Sofía no puede permitir que la chica que fue su mejor amiga sea ahora la esposa de su padre. Marlon exige el divorcio de Salma y la custodia de su hijo. Salma no quiere divorciarse.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: El pasado de la frontera; Quiero mis $93 000 por violación
programme.desc: Mary adoptó al hijo de Mónica sin su consentimiento. Fernanda recibió 100 mil dólares cuando tenía 15 años; ahora, con 21, descubre que su madre y su hermano se han gastado casi todo el dinero.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: La casa de todos; Mal de rabia
programme.desc: Vino de Venezuela con su esposo y compraron una propiedad; a sus espaldas, él se casó con otra mujer y la metió a vivir en su casa. Cada vez que se enfurece, Orlando abusa físicamente de Eddie.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mr. Black Serrucho; Niña sorda con tío
programme.desc: La melodía del serrucho vuelve loca a Maritza. Su marido le pide tratamiento psicológico. Gustavo exige la custodia de su sobrina sordomuda y que la madre de la pequeña desaloje la casa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su nieta tiene un novio que mantiene una relación con otro hombre y a su madre le parece bien. Una mujer padece el síndrome del acaparador compulsivo y en su casa no se puede vivir.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Sin hambre no tendrá deseo sexual; Embarazada sin beneficio
programme.desc: Un padre le da hierbas a su hija de ocho años porque la vio tocarse, la madre está preocupada por la seguridad de su hija. Fátima es una cartera que fue despedida por estar embarazada.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amputada y sin hijas; Mamá vende droga en hospital
programme.desc: Por culpa de su marido, Ana perdió una pierna y a sus hijos; ahora pide el divorcio y la custodia de sus hijas. Alexis exige que Jorge se haga cargo de su mamá, la señora que trafica drogas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Se mudan por amenaza de las Farc; Niña adoptada, madre drogadicta
programme.desc: Nelson todavía sufre por las amenazas que recibió en Colombia. Carlos exige una orden de alejamiento para Ximena, quien quiere recuperar a su hija a pesar de que continúa metida en drogas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Todo queda en familia; Herencia mía, deuda tuya
programme.desc: Nachi y Enrique son hermanos, conviven con una mujer y los dos están enamorados de ella. Javier exige que Carmen, la pareja de su padre, pague la deuda que dejó su progenitor antes de morir.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liliana pagó 100 000 dólares por el rescate de Daniela, pero está convencida de que su hermana planificó el secuestro para estafarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Ahora mujer para pastora; ¿Se valida el pre-nup o el testamento?
programme.desc: Natasha exige la custodia de su hijo, Brend alega que la ama y que quiere seguir con ella. Un difunto le dejó la herencia a su exmujer, pero su actual esposa tiene un poder para quedarse con todo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Quiero volver a Venezuela; Renuncio a la herencia
programme.desc: Stephanie vino a vivir con su padre y quiere regresar a Venezuela porque él es alcohólico, vive en un tráiler y no se ocupa de ella. Además, tres hermanos se pelean por la herencia de su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Joaquín se lesionó cuando jugaba en el equipo de fútbol de su empresa. El dueño se niega a pagarle el sueldo mientras se recupera. José exige que el padre de su nieto se haga cargo del menor.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Empresario en bancarrota; Disciplinando a su hija
programme.desc: Claudia recibió una golpiza de una mujer que contrató Ignacio y exige que él le pague 200 000 dólares por daños y perjuicios. Una adolescente rebelde no quiere más castigos corporales de su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Mi rival es una perra; Papá por favor quiéreme
programme.desc: Liliana tiene un problema grave: su marido prefiere a su perra, hasta en la cama. Jean es un adolescente desesperado, su padre alcohólico lo desprecia, su única posibilidad es un tío tiránico.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.sub-title: Amante venérea; Roomate seduce por dinero

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la agencia siguen con la repartición de regalos. Olegario y Junior están acompañando a Fabián que está sumamente triste por no estar pasándola con su Finita e hijas. En la agencia siguen con los regalos. Ana ya le regaló a Pastor y Pastor a Mauricio. Lolita y Dionisia quieren atender a ROKUro como un rey. El tiene pena. Carolina sigue pensando en el beso de Segundo y viendo la hora que es y Juan Diego no la llama. Juan Diego le regala a Yubiri y se abrazan.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Gabriel conoce a Magdalena. Ella es la encargada de sacarle las fotos para la campaña publicitaria. Es muy dulce y queda enganchado con ella. Epicúreo va a entrevistar a Valentina Pacheco, pero con una información errónea. Y ella empieza a pensar en la hija que tuvo y dio, mediante fecundación in Vitro. Julieta siente que está defraudando a sus padres, por trabajar en un periódico de chimentos. Angie (esposa de Gabriel) está muy enojada porque él apaga su teléfono y no consigue localizarlo. Magdalena invita a Sofía (su ginecóloga) a cenar a su casa para ver si existe la posibilidad de tener otro hijo. Agustín se enoja con Sofía (que es su amante). Ya que le había pedido que dijera que eso era imposible, sin embargo Sofía afirma lo contrario.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Moisés descubre la verdad sobre su padre biológico y confronta a Benjamín. Alejandro confiesa que no es cura. La muerte de la Nona en Italia sacude a todos, mientras Katiuska y Hortensia conspiran con Benjamín para robar el testamento y asegurar la herencia. Manuela enfrenta insultos de su familia tras dar la noticia de la muerte. Entre tensiones familiares y revelaciones de secretos del pasado, los personajes lidian con el caos, el alcoholismo y la ambición por la fortuna.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Isaías culpa a Eustoquio de su pasada estancia en cárcel por los dólares falsos. Alejandro engaña a Arminda haciéndola creer en una cita; Consuelo se prepara. Eustoquio manipula a Isaías ofreciéndole dinero para pagarle a Adolfo. José Luis prepara una operación comando con sus amigos para rescatar a Natalia. El médico informa a Adolfo y Marisela que a Junior le queda poco tiempo de vida. Consuelo amenaza con matar a Arminda; ella revela que la hija está viva. Carmen Rosa se ahoga en sus recuerdos del pasado. Leticia descubre que su carro no tiene frenos y entra en pánico.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto y Leonardo hablan acerca de las sospechas del segundo sobre la verdadera paternidad de Mateo, el hijo de Irene. Sin que ellos lo sepan, Rebeca los está escuchando. Virginia y Jimena se reconcilian y le comunican la buena nueva a Carlos Ernesto, quien se muestra feliz y agradecido. Leo es liberado de la cárcel y se reencuentra con su padre. En una molesta discusión, pregunta si cuando se vuelvan a casar, van a firmar la separación de bienes. Sandra invita a salir a Fernando para poder mostrarle que María Lucía está de novia y muy feliz con Damián. Trinidad le cuenta a Zulay la propuesta de Anzola y Zulay la insta a aceptarla. Al mismo tiempo, Anzola se lamenta con Coromoto por la negativa de Trinidad.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto logra escapar de la cárcel y le pasa información a Maricielo sobre el posible escondite al que Reina irá con Alejandro. La policía consigue dar con los secuestradores y recuperar sano y salvo a Alejandro, pero Reina se da a la fuga. A último momento, es interceptada por las patrullas. Luego, Heriberto se dirige a la casa de Sol y le dice que ha ayudado a la policía para recuperar a Alejandro. Ella confía en él pero, al momento de brindar, Heriberto le pone una droga en su bebida.

programme.title: Great Destinations Asia
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.sub-title: Kruger Sunset Bush Dinner, Klaserie, South Africa
programme.desc: Food blogger and cookbook author, Sarah Graham, takes her kitchen on the road through Africa.

programme.title: Hidden Italy
programme.sub-title: The State of the Presidi and the Maremma
programme.desc: The State of the Presidi is a swampy, malarial land, which, thanks only to human resilience and intelligence, became a centre of wealth and culture. The journey starts from the Metalliferous Hills of Maremma, rich in raw metals and the historical capital of mining territory, and continues to the historical buildings and the ancient water springs of Massa Maratima with its famous Fertility Tree.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the premiere of It's A Beautiful World, Jeff Fuchs joins a team of doctors as they navigate the vast waterways of the Amazon River to deliver vital healthcare to remote Indigenous communities. Set in the tri-border region between Colombia, Brazil, and Peru, this episode offers a powerful look at medicine, resilience, and human connection in one of the most isolated places on Earth.

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.sub-title: American Travelers: The Great South West
programme.desc: Dave and Kari take their viewers on a tour of the South Western states of the United States.

programme.title: Brent Owens Unwraps Mauritius
programme.desc: Arriving at the stunning resort of LUX* Belle Mare, Brent is amazed by their stylish, contemporary spin on luxury hospitality. Surrounded by tropical gardens and pristine white beaches, this is what everyone imagines Mauritius to be and more. He meets up with Chef Nicolas where they cook up a seafood specialty which they then enjoy under the sun on the beach. With a reef nearby, Brent rents a glass bottomed kayak and paddles out to check out the sea life. Then hopping on a bicycle, he rides to a nearby market to get the ingredients he needs for his take on a Chef Nicolas's dish, Mauritian lobster rolls, which he prepares under shady palms.

programme.desc: This town is right on the banks of the Potomac River. Join Brian and Nick as they hit The Bavarian Inn, explore the town's history, make gourmet popcorn, and visit the battlefield that is known as The Bloodiest Day in American History.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.sub-title: Road Trip Masters: Old Saybrook, CT
programme.desc: Nick road trips to actress Katharine Hepburn's hometown of Old Saybrook. He tours The Kate, learns what the locals are doing to revive the oyster beds, cooks up some sea scallops at Liv's, and hits the shores in search of oystercatchers.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Wellsboro PA aka The Town That Saved Christmas is a classic storybook town with nostalgic gas-lit streets. Nick quickly finds out about its glassmaking past and comes across a chocolate factory with an incredible mission. He chows down at the Steak House and travels deep into the PA Grand Canyon!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick rolls into to this central pa town and visits the historic Campus Theater where he satisfies one of his life long quests. Then he checks out a restaurant that has mastered the art of the smashburger! He'll witness the making of some of the best snowboards in the world, then close out this road trip by hitting Mecum's Auto Auction where the Caddy awaits him after its new restoration.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.sub-title: Road Trip Masters: Harpers Ferry, WV
programme.desc: This gem in the beautiful Mountain State is known for its connection to John Brown's raid. Hop in the seat and ride along as Nick travels back in time to a candy store that uses centuries old recipes and chows down at a restaurant specializing in vegan delights. Then take a walk on the Appalachian Trail with an AT Legend!

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: This historic town northwest of Boston played a significant role in the American Revolutionary War. Come along as Nick explores the Minuteman National Historical Park, visits the Concord Museum, and takes a stroll through Authors Ridge, the resting place of famous authors such as Henry David Thoreau and Ralph Waldo Emerson. Discover the rich history of this charming New England town.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick check out the Caboose Motel, indulge in delicious eats at Fat Chad's, and learn about the influential journalist Ida Tarbell. They make some smiley cookies and of course find out all they can about the birthplace of the oil industry and the global impact Titusville had on the rest of the world.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.sub-title: Road Trip Masters: Spring Lake, NJ
programme.desc: Nick travels to a New Jersey beach town known as "the bubble" where he visits not one but two chocolate shops that make time tested treats. Then he hits a seafood restaurant serving the freshest of fresh blue fin tuna. He tours a historic home, visits the local theater and museum then rides drop top around town to take in the stunning residential architecture.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Brian and Nick hit the "Marble City" Rutland, Vermont! Join them as they explore the Red Clover Inn, Table 24 and the Vermont Marble Museum. Then hit the hills and checkout some mountain adventure.

programme.title: Great Destinations Asia
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

The German General Staff thinks taking the city will be a matter of a few weeks, but events steadily turn against the Germans.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: The Greatest coordination of arms ever portrayed in the world. Every scene made during the greatest victory of Allied power, to date. 11,000 Allied planes plant their tons of pulverizing bombs on shore installations, strategic roads and bridges, then swoop down to strafe enemy trains, ships and planes. The air poundings continue, and the mop-up search for snipers is on. The invasion is successful.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days

Hewitt in a landing craft.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former teacher Tanya Ramirez pled guilty for crossing a forbidden line… having sex with a 17-year-old student who attended the school where she taught, and now, she’s done something many find even more unbelievable, she’s suing him and his mother. After pleading guilty to this charge, Ramirez filed a lawsuit against the teen accusing him of “extreme and outrageous” conduct and invasion of privacy for recording their late-night rendezvous. Ramirez claims the teen showed the tape around school for bragging rights. Ramirez says the sex was consensual, and says the student is an adult and he was just fine after the encounter. Teacher and student face off on Dr. Phil’s stage for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If your loved one has an unusual behavior, does that mean he or she is not normal? Dustin says his wife, Gina’s, behavior when she shops is not normal, and it’s gotten so extreme he wants a divorce. What’s at the root of Gina’s ways? Is it really related to shopping, or is there something deeper driving her behavior? Next, Ryan says his wife’s idea to pay off their debt is risky, dangerous and could kill her. Will Dr. Phil’s stern warning make this mom change her plans? Then, Billy has had 30 jobs in seven years, and his mom says that’s not normal. Is Billy just lazy, or is there another reason he can’t keep a job? And, take a quiz to see how normal you are!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you’ve got it, flaunt it! Dr. Phil's guests say they’ve gone from ugly ducklings to hot tamales, but their loved ones think they’ve gone too far. Audrey says she looks extra hot now that she's 62 ... and she's got a 28-year-old boyfriend to prove it! Her close friend, Crystal, thinks Audrey should hang up her miniskirts and start baking cookies. Then, Bobbie lost 140 pounds and gained an insanely jealous husband because he thinks she looks way too sexy. See what happens when cameras follow Bobbie for a night on the town. Plus, a winner of the popular makeover show “The Swan” says she doesn't know how to handle her newfound beauty.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Morgan and Ashley claim their mom, Treva, is “a toxic, violent alcoholic,” who they say is way out of control, and that although she’s been to rehab eight times, she’s never stayed sober. In the past year, Morgan says the police have been called to the house 57 times for violence, threats, assault and even arson. Morgan says if her mom doesn’t stop her excessive drinking and end the violence, she will walk away for good. Treva says she does not want to go to another “dumb treatment center” as she is “done with them” and claims they do not work for her. Treva has said that she believes the problem is 10% her and 90% everyone else – and that she believes her family needs an intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On July 6, 2012, 16-year-old Skylar Neese was stabbed to death by her two best friends, Shelia Eddy and Rachel Shoaf. Six months later, Rachel confessed to police and led them to Skylar’s remains. Shelia continued to plead not guilty -- until January 2014, when she finally admitted her part in the brutal murder. Both teens claimed they killed Skylar because they “didn’t want to be friends with her anymore” -- but was that their real motive? And, who was the mastermind behind the plot? Dr. Phil sits down with Sklylar’s parents, Dave and Mary, who say they’re struggling to comprehend what happened to their little girl. How can they heal after such a horrific tragedy? And, how could Shelia -- who had been friends with Skylar since she was 8 -- and Rachel commit such a heinous crime? Hear from Shelia’s cousin, who says Shelia isn’t the monster people say she is. And, friends of Rachel’s family weigh in. Were there any red flags they say they missed? Then, a close friend of Shelia and Skylar claims she knows the real reason behind the murder. Does Skylar’s journal entry confirm her suspicions?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you’re a bride-to-be, planning your wedding can be an emotional time for you and your parents. But what happens when your family members are not exactly jumping for joy over your upcoming nuptials? From a mom who is worried her daughter is rushing into a marriage with a complete stranger to a bride who says her father is ruining her big day, Dr. Phil helps families figure out how to keep the happiest day in a young couple’s life from turning into a nightmare. And, are you sure you're preparing for a marriage and not just a wedding? Find out the questions you must ask yourself before walking down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Celebrities seem to do it every day: short engagements and quick marriages. In his book, Love Smart: Find the One You Want - Fix the One You Got, Dr. Phil says everybody deserves a loving relationship, but there is a right way, a smart way, to find your Mr. or Ms. Right. Do fast engagements and marriages work, or is it a recipe for disaster?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Good fences make good neighbors, but Dr. Phil's guests say no matter how high the fence, they can't seem to end their vicious feud.

programme.desc: Dr. Phil follows up with a family terrified for the safety of their loved one, Katherine, a young woman who flew to the Middle East to be with Abdullah, whom she met online. Get caught up on what you missed in Part 1 and Part 2.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Guests want to know if their loved one's behavior is off the charts. One man says his wife's love of four-legged creatures has turned his home into a zoo with 60 pets! Then, a guest who says her fiancé’s love of sports is out of control… and a woman whose shopping habits may cost her an engagement ring. Plus—a husband who showers once a week and rarely brushes his teeth!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: The Doctor, The Wife, The Mistress
programme.desc: It's the affair that has everyone talking! Ed, a successful doctor, revealed to his wife, Kandi, that he was having an affair and his mistress is pregnant. Now, with the baby due in less than eight weeks, Dr. Phil checks back in.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: 80% of all communication is non-verbal, and, as the old saying goes, you never get a second chance to make a first impression. In this episode, Dr. Phil focuses on body language and appearance rather than the words we speak. Learn from one couple how the little things we do can mean more than saying “I love you.” Plus, is she simply a self-confident woman, or are her actions driving men away?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sisters Rylie, 23, and Lenae, 26, claim their father, Leonard, was extremely physically and verbally abusive during their childhood and that they lived in constant fear of him — allegations he absolutely denies. They also claim their mother, Susan, did not protect them from him. Rylie claims the alleged abuse was so damaging that she believes it’s the cause of her diagnosis of Borderline Personality Disorder. Lenae says the many years of alleged verbal abuse have led to self-loathing and even an eating disorder. Leonard admits to having a tough disciplinary style, but refutes his daughters accusations — even saying they’ve blown everything out of proportion.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine if you found out your teenage daughter was falling in love with an older man on the Internet, concocting a plan to be together, 5,591 miles away in a war-torn country. This is an alert to all parents: Do you know what your child is doing on the computer?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Screaming, making excuses, irrational outbursts ... No one knows how a drug addict behaves better than Brandon. With five years of sobriety under his belt, he and his mother, Debbie, are paying it forward. Now, Brandon meets his match! After seeing Dr. Phil’s intervention with Karli, Kim wrote to Dr. Phil for help with her 23-year-old daughter, Jaime, who's addicted to OxyContin. Five months ago, Kim’s family performed an intervention with Jaime. After agreeing to go to a detox facility, Jaime checked herself out and tried to commit suicide. Now, Kim says the young woman has started injecting cocaine and takes any opiate she can get her hands on. Don’t miss the most dramatic intervention yet. Will Jaime finally agree to get treatment, or will she fight everyone tooth and nail? Plus, addicted to heroin and OxyContin, Karli had overdosed and relapsed many times before her mother brought her to Dr. Phil and Brandon for help. How is she now?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Spoiled, Lazy, Adult Rapper Son
programme.desc: Cindy and Jim say they are fed up with their 35-year-old son, Brandon. They say he’s a moocher who refuses to get job, wears superhero costumes on a daily basis, and has caused $15,000 in damages to their property. Brandon says his parents don’t understand how his mind works. He admits to wearing superhero costumes and going on nightly “Batman” vigilante missions. Brandon says he also created a rapper persona named “Ceeza Caprice” and considers himself a “God MC” who can rap to any beat. Brandon’s sister, Harmony, says she blames her parents for Brandon’s behavior. She says they enable Brandon. She claims Brandon is a manipulator who sees it as a challenge to live off others.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents Liz and Jim say their 16-year-old son, Nic, has a serious drug problem that has such a hold on him, they claim he even stole $75,000 in gold from his parents’ safe and spent it all on drugs! But, Liz says she is convinced that her husband is to blame. Liz accuses Jim of being a narcissist and misogynist, whose parenting philosophy is based on intimidation and abuse, and claims that is what drove their son to drugs. Jim denies Liz’s allegations, claiming she has gone to great lengths to paint him as a villain. He says she is the major problem, and calls her the world's lousiest parent and a doormat who helped enable Nic's deadly addictions.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In this powerful program, Dr. Phil exposes the frightening yet underreported problem of mothers on the verge on committing child abuse. We meet ordinary women who live in fear that they’re going to hurt their children in a fit of uncontrollable rage. Chrystel says she feels rage and snaps and then it gets to the point where there's no return. Jessica says her fits of rage become so intense, she's scared that she will hurt her son. Answering their desperate pleas for help, Dr. Phil explains how to identify cues leading up to this precarious state, and tells moms what to do when they start to lose control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on with Dr. Phil guests when the show is over? Get a sneak peek backstage after explosive episodes and find out what happens when the guests return home.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tiffany and Mindy describe their mother, Phyllis, as “the most selfish person on the face of the earth.” They say their entire childhoods were affected by her self-absorbed behavior, ultimately fracturing their relationship. Tiffany says she worries she won’t even be able to come up with anything nice to say about her mother at her funeral. Phyllis insists she was a great mother, and her daughters have it all wrong. Dr. Phil goes over some of the incidents her daughters report as manipulative and self-centered. Will Phyllis own up to her parenting mistakes and apologize? And, Chanell says her friend, Shauna, suffers from “Pretty Girl Selfish Syndrome” and needs an intervention. Shauna says she’s open to a minor tweak in her behavior, but a major overhaul is out of the question. And, see the remarkable progress of two women who Dr. Phil says should be selfish and put themselves first: Amanda and Bekki from the 17 Day Diet Challenge. Plus, Dr. Phil celebrates his 1500th show with his oldest and youngest fans!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Still Missing: Where Is 7 yo Kyron?
programme.desc: It’s been more than three years since 7-year-old Kyron Horman disappeared -- and the case still remains unsolved. Kyron’s divorced parents, Desiree and Kaine, come together in an exclusive interview with Dr. Phil. Hear why they say they believe Kyron’s stepmother, Terri, may know more that she’s admitting.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: YouTube sensation “Homeless Joe,” 26, survives on the mean streets of Manhattan by panhandling during the day and picking up women at night. Joe admits he could get a place of his own if he stopped drinking but says being homeless without alcohol is unbearable. Is this “cardboard Casanova” interested in turning his life around?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s being called the ultimate form of child abuse -- brainwashing your children against an ex-spouse to win custody. Could you be harming your child emotionally and not even know it? First up, Ken is a successful surgeon who says he’s the victim of parental alienation syndrome (PAS). He says he hasn’t seen his 14-year-old son since last October and claims his ex-wife destroyed what was once a loving father-son relationship. Mel Feit, director of the National Center for Men, says Ken’s situation is a classic case of kids being turned against their father, but family law attorney Liz Kates says PAS is a phony tactic used by some men to get out of paying child support. What does Dr. Phil think? Then, Karen lost custody of her children after she was accused of parental alienation syndrome by her ex-husband. Karen maintains her innocence, so why were her parental rights terminated when her daughters accused her ex of sexual abuse? Plus, 19-year-old Demi joins the show via Web cam and says her father verbally abused her mother during their divorce. Now, she fears that her 15-year-old sister is caught in the middle. Find out what you can do if you’re caught between sparring parents. And, meet a father so desperate to see his young children, he kidnapped them from his ex-wife and went on the lam for two years.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The four couples continue with the last leg of the teamwork challenge. After purchasing food at the market, the teams return to The House to cook their meal. Team One again finishes first, while Team Two doesn't even try, complaining about the unfairness of the game. Steve accuses Team One of cheating, which angers Lacey, who hates sore losers. After Stephanie brings up Scott's questionable tactics in the Hitched or Ditched game, Scott apologizes for cheating.Since the women complain that their fiancés don't pay enough attention to them, Dr. Phil invites some good-looking gentlemen to the house to shower the women with attention. While each woman has a one-on-one talk with an attractive stranger, the men secretly watch. All the women except Lilly don't hold back, telling the complete strangers the good, the bad and the ugly about their relationships. While Scott, Steve and Kalin confront their fiancées about what they revealed to the stranger, Tim and Lilly feel out of place, thinking their problems are minute compared to the others'. Dr. Phil has another meeting with the couples, and again asks them to stand up if they think they should get married. This time, only Tim, Lilly and Stephanie stand. Dr. Phil confronts Kalin about his anger and Lacey about her willingness to stay in an abusive relationship. Kalin admits that he needs help and says he doesn't want to be a monster. Dr. Phil tells Steve that if he marries Stephanie, she will make him miserable for the rest of his life. Stephanie agrees, and Dr. Phil points out that Steve just might be a nice guy who happens to love her. Will she stop trying to control him? Then, Scott asks Dr. Phil about how to deal with anxiety and depression, and Dr. Phil offers to help him obtain a proper evaluation and diagnosis. A grateful Scott and Lisa cry and hug each other. And, although Lilly and Tim think they don't fit in with the other members of the house, Dr. Phil assures them that they have a lot of work to do as well to be ready for marriage. He asks all the couples to think about whether they have realistic expectations, and tells them that they are all guilty of contaminating their relationships.Since money is the leading cause of divorce, Dr. Phil sets the couples up with money expert Marilyn Logan, who quizzes them about how well they know their partner's financial situation. The couples answer truthfully, but Lisa again embarrasses Scott by laying out all his financial missteps in sarcastic detail. At the end, Marilyn deems Tim and Lilly the winners of $20,000 from LowerMyBills.com. Go inside The House.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former high school dance teacher Anne, 35, made national headlines when it was revealed that her two children -- ages 3 and 2 -- were fathered by Bradman, a former student who is 14 years her junior. Bradman, now 21, is claiming that their physical relationship began when he was 15 and that Anne made the first move. Facing possible prison time on two felony charges, Anne turns to Dr. Phil to tell her side of the story. Why does she believe that she is the victim? And, why does she say she filed a protective order against Bradman? Then, Bradman takes the stage to tell his side of the story. Why does he say he didn't reveal the nature of their relationship sooner? And, why is he coming forward now? It's a don't miss Dr. Phil!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does love really conquer all? James, 41, quit his job and left his wife and three children to pursue a relationship with his 18-year-old former student, Jordan. The couple says they're not breaking any laws, want to set the record straight with Dr. Phil, and want Jordan's mother, Tammie, to stop her Facebook "smear campaign" against them. In a national exclusive, Tammie confronts James for the first time on Dr. Phil’s stage. Find out how the attraction began and why Tammie says James is lying. Were there secret meetings before Jordan turned 18? And, what does Jordan stand to lose? Parents, how would you react if your child started a relationship with his or her former teacher?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In the summer of 2014, a former middle school English teacher was arrested on suspicion of statutory rape and contributing to the delinquency of a minor after police found her in a motel room with a 15-year-old former student. In a Dr. Phil exclusive, Jennifer Caswell speaks out for the first time. How does she explain her relationship with her former student?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former teacher Tanya Ramirez pled guilty for crossing a forbidden line… having sex with a 17-year-old student who attended the school where she taught, and now, she’s done something many find even more unbelievable, she’s suing him and his mother. Ramirez claims the teen showed the tape around school for bragging rights. Ramirez says the sex was consensual, and says the student is an adult and he was just fine after the encounter. programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some teachers today are turning schoolboy fantasies into sexual realities with their inappropriate conduct towards underage students. Mary Kay Letourneau, who admitted to authorities that she had sex with a 13-year-old former student; Debra Lafave, accused of having sex with a 14-year-old student, and Pamela Rogers, accused of sending sexually-explicit videos to a 14-year-old boy, are just a few examples.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explores a disturbing trend: Female teachers engaging in sex acts with their underage male students. The number of accusations has doubled in the past five years. You've probably heard of famous cases like Mary Kay Letourneau, Debra Lafave and the recent case of a teacher in Southern California, Meredith Johnson Vincent, who was arrested on suspicion of having a sexual relationship with a 14-year-old boy. Dr. Phil meets one teacher who has chosen to fight back.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his look at a teacher sex scandal that has a school and families divided in a small town in Texas. High school teacher Joelle Ogletree faces accusations of sexual misconduct with some of her male students. Hear both sides of this gripping sex scandal from the accuser and the accused, and judge for yourself if justice has been served.

programme.title: Four In A Bed
programme.desc: The second visit is to La Tavola Calda in Nuneaton, where father and son team Mick and Chris Emanuele run a basic B&B aimed at contract workers above their Italian restaurant.

programme.title: Four In A Bed

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Plagued by persistent and frustrating body problems like dandruff, blackheads or excessive sweating? The latest installment of Ask Our Doctors shows you how to get rid of pesky ailments for good!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Runny noses, stuffy heads and aching bodies can only mean one thing: cold and flu season is in full swing. Find out 40 ways to fight the flu and outsmart a cold! Plus, the latest technology to keep your gadgets germ-free.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Backaches, allergies and toothaches are among the most common recurring health problems. Find out how to keep your chronic medical issues from coming back, and learn to keep body odor and bad breath at bay.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: In a The Doctors exclusive, a woman’s courage to donate her late husband’s face leads to a ground-breaking facial transplant with unbelievable results! In another exclusive, a mother reveals how the pressure to breastfeed her baby led her to accidentally starve her son. Reality star Laura Govan stops by for some advice on a personal health issue! Plus, the tweet that triggered a seizure … how’s that possible? And, a ssss-soothing massage by snakes? Meet Marnie The Dog!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: We’re tackling everything from your common questions to your most embarrassing questions in our medical confessional! Then, The “Stool Squad” is back to answer all your bathroom-related questions! And, fixes for a chubby face without going under the knife! And, The surprising reason why one woman’s nose is constantly running for 7 years. Then, Dr. Nita reveals the everyday habit that could lead to a yeast infection! Next, new research says sparkling water is making you fat. But is true? And, we’re revealing the top hacks to ease your winter driving woes!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Ask Our Drs: Why Does That Smell?
programme.desc: From foul gas to smelly ears, The Doctors answer your most pressing questions about the odors your body produces. And, editor-in-chief of Prevention, Liz Vaccariello, separates fact from fiction about a common medical myth.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors “Race to Erase 10 Years” on a lucky audience member! Just wait until you see The jaw-dropping results! Candle explosion: could it happen to you? People are suing The major cereal companies over “nutritious” and “wholesome” claims! Guest loses 170 pounds but it isn’t enough! Find out what still is weighing her down. The Doctors discusses a new study that claims going vegan leads to depression! Product claims to whiten teeth 6 shades lighter in just 3 days? Does it work or is it 50 shades of disappointment? We’re putting it to The test! Plus, The water bottle danger you haven’t heard!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Improve your health from A to Z! From anti-aging to zits, The Doctors tackle common health concerns and share the latest medical treatments, simple cures and surprising tips to keep you in tip-top shape.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Caught on tape: a public meltdown at the gym! What to do when someone flies off the handle in public! Then, a 90-pound weight loss without surgery? Hear one woman’s personal tips that helped her get trim! And, The voice of beloved cartoon characters like Bugs Bunny, Ren and Stimpy, Doug and Futurama reveals his story of overcoming prostate cancer! The risk factors all men need to know! Plus, legendary Latin King of Comedy Paul Rodriguez opens up about his sister’s tragic diabetic death. Hear his heartache and his desire to improve his own personal health. Then, if you’re one of the 42 million Americans struggling with constipation, proctologist Dr. David Rosenfeld shares his top foods that can help you poop! Plus, a sweet trick for a bug-free BBQ!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Whether it’s puberty, menopause or old age, learn how to stay healthy at every age. Plus, get the ultimate guide to treating adolescent acne, and learn how to help your baby take his or first steps!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: From lips and legs to labor and libido, The Doctors explores the “L” words everyone loves or loathes and gives you the tools to start feeling and looking your absolute best! And find out the best ways to fight lethargy.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A cervical cancer test in the doctor's office is saving lives. See it performed live. And, Amanda lost 180 pounds, but excess skin and fat hung from her body. See The Total Body Lift surgery that allowed her to reclaim her life!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: Treat It Now or Pay Later?
programme.desc: Actress Sally Field joins The Doctors to raise awareness about osteoporosis, a bone-thinning disease that affects four times more women than men. Learn steps to take to preserve the health of your bones.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Investigation into home food sensitivity tests – are they legit or a waste of a time and money? Shocking story of mom’s debilitating stimulant addiction! Class action lawsuit over vitamin shots? The craziest things dogs have eaten in “My Dog Ate What?”

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Staying healthy can sometimes feel like a challenge too large to overcome. Talk-show host Montel Williams joins THE DOCTORS to help you take charge of your health! Previously on THE DOCTORS, Montel helped motivate Alex, who suffers from dystonia. See how she is doing now and learn about a procedure that may help Alex overcome the disorder! Do your family dinners lack the proper nutrition? Montel makes a house call and provides one family with an action plan for healthier eating. The outbreak of the swine flu caused a nationwide scare. Now, the vaccine for the strain of flu is cause for concern. Former acting U.S. Surgeon General, Steven J, Galson, answers your H1N1 vaccine questions.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: A breakthrough eye surgery allows a legally blind man to see again. And, Brian Littrell of The Backstreet Boys opens up about his 6-year-old son's fight with Kawasaki Disease. Learn how to spot the warning signs in your child.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Do you get body tremors? Does your butt jiggle? Do you tremble when you get a high fever? Learn why your body shakes, shimmies and shivers! And, shake your way to a better physique.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: Tone, tighten and sculpt your booty with celebrity trainer David Kirsch’s signature exercises! And, how to get rid of adult acne, eliminate crow’s feet and look a size smaller in less than 60 seconds!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: From backaches, to headaches to earaches, learn simple solutions to relieve nagging aches and pains. And, learn a unique and effective way to treat colicky babies.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.sub-title: My Bikini Wax Almost Killed Me
programme.desc: Burns, bleeding and infections are just a few of the dangers associated with waxing. But what about death? Meet a woman who almost lost her life after a bikini wax. And, learn secret beauty tips from a celebrity makeup artist!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: From a grumbling stomach, to a gassy gut to ringing ears, find out which body noises are hazardous, which are harmless and how to mute them.

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: The Doctors checks in with a Season 10 guest who dropped over 300 pounds naturally after he received one of the most graphic skin removal surgeries ever! How is he doing today and what weight-loss advice does he have? “Good & Cheap” author teaches us how to eat healthy for four dollars a day! Controversial study claims women should have shorter workweeks than men? What do our hosts think? Smartphone notifications aren’t just annoying – They might be messing up your brain permanently!

programme.title: The Doctors
programme.desc: It’s THE DOCTORS’ Thanksgiving Leftover Show packed with goodies that didn’t fit on our first plate! In a new edition of The Doc Tank, we bring you wild and wacky health products from a pancake robot to a bike you ride laying down to a pillow that claims to help you snooze more soundly! Then, why do women cheat? Could Instagram be fueling infidelity? Go inside a training camp for service dogs to watch them transform from pup to personal assistant! She presses him to sort out what he wants from her, and a relationship develops. They talk of traveling. He confides in his friend, George, a poet long-married, who advises David to grow up and grow old. She invites him to meet her family. His own son, from a long-ended marriage, confronts him. programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E05 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!
